source.snippet: I wish there was a tool to monitor if some random process is accessing folder X or has high network usage, a la Little Snitch on Mac. Linux desktop doesn't have this.

problem_statement: Linux desktop users and developers have no user-friendly, real-time process-level network and filesystem access monitor equivalent to Little Snitch on macOS, making it hard to detect unexpected application behaviour on their workstations.
target_segment: Security-conscious developers and power users running Linux desktops who want application-level network and file-access visibility.
notes: Single HN comment (2021) but the gap is real and persistent — Little Snitch earns ~$45/license on Mac, suggesting this market pays. Linux professional developer audience is a plausible buyer segment. Needs more corroborating signals.
